recommendations.summary: Here are some MWM-listed spots in Los Angeles worth checking out.

businesses.name: Griot's Coffee & Study Hall
businesses.description: A community coffee house and study space in the heart of Crenshaw. Specialty coffee, African teas, and a safe space for creators, students, and thinkers.

businesses.name: Post & Beam
businesses.description: A Black-owned restaurant in Baldwin Hills offering California comfort food, serving as a staple for the local community. This restaurant brings farm-to-table sensibility to comfort food traditions, creating a dining experience that reflects both California's food culture and the Black community's culinary heritage.

businesses.name: Earle's on Crenshaw
businesses.description: A long-standing family-owned business in the Crenshaw District offering hot dogs, Jamaican patties, and vegan options. This multi-generational business represents the kind of community institution that has served the Crenshaw corridor for decades, adapting to changing tastes while maintaining its role as a neighborhood gathering place.

businesses.name: Meals by Genet
businesses.description: A beloved eatery in Little Ethiopia offering traditional Ethiopian dishes, famous for its intricate dorowat. Located in the heart of LA's Ethiopian community — the largest outside of Ethiopia — this restaurant represents the pinnacle of Ethiopian cooking in America, with dishes prepared with the care and complexity that define the cuisine at its best.

businesses.name: Guelaguetza
businesses.description: A James Beard Award-winning restaurant in Koreatown known for its authentic Oaxacan cuisine and vibrant cultural atmosphere. This family-owned restaurant has brought the complex, ancient culinary traditions of Oaxaca — including mole, tlayudas, and mezcal — to national prominence, earning recognition as one of the finest Mexican restaurants in the country.

businesses.name: Ayara Thai Cuisine
businesses.description: A family-owned restaurant in Westchester offering authentic Thai recipes passed down through generations. This restaurant represents the Thai community's culinary heritage in Los Angeles, offering dishes prepared from family recipes that connect diners to the authentic flavors of Thailand.
